title: Claude for Google Workspace™
format_note: Title card, then one 40.7 s screen-recorded walkthrough of Claude inside Docs, Sheets and Slides, ending on a tagline and logo. No voiceover.
one_thing: Claude lives in the side panel of Docs, Sheets and Slides, and one typed request returns finished work in each.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. The caption track holds only [music] tags and one stray '>> Mhm.' at 0:59, which is music, not a voice.
transcript.script_shape: All copy is on screen: a 5-word title, three typed user prompts with Claude's replies in the panel, a 4-word tagline, then the logo.

structure.frame0: Three Google app icons (Docs blue, Sheets green, Slides yellow) on a warm cream ground, with 'Introducing Claude for Google Workspace' under them. Subject and title are present at t=0.
structure.first_3s: Icons drift up and shrink slightly while the two-line title fades in from 0.8 s; by 1.3 s the title is fully set and holds until the cut at 4.54 s.

beats.what: Title card: three app icons and 'Introducing Claude for Google Workspace'.
Docs window, then zoom to the Extensions menu and the Claude entry under it.
Docs panel slides in; prompt 'Tighten up the executive summary...' is answered and the document restyles.
Sheets: two CSVs are dragged in, the budget prompt is typed, 'Working on it...' shows.
A coral gradient sweeps across the empty sheet and resolves into a finished budget-vs-actuals report with KPI tiles and status cells.
Slides: the plus menu opens, Connectors lists Salesforce and Google Drive, both toggled on.
'Build a QBR deck for Northfield...' is typed; Claude reports it found three call notes, a usage report and the Salesforce renewal.
Finished six-slide Northfield QBR deck with a green title slide.
Browser window slides up and away; 'Claude wherever you work' fades in and out.
Coral sunburst and Claude wordmark on cream, held through to the end.

hero_moment.what: The coral gradient sweep that turns an empty spreadsheet into a finished, formatted report (f0016.jpg); it is the film's only non-UI graphic motion.

ending.what: Tagline holds about 2.6 s, fades to blank cream, then the Claude logo holds about 6.3 s with silence from 58.46 s.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Four cuts in the first 10 s, then one 40.7 s shot (68 % of runtime) where camera zooms and UI state changes carry all change. No burst. Interest comes from typing, zoom-ins and result reveals, not from cutting.

look.ground: Warm off-white cream, light in every sampled frame (light_share 1.0, luma 239.1); the browser window floats on it with a soft shadow.
palette: Docs blue / Sheets green / Slides yellow icons
look.accent_use: Coral appears only on the Claude mark (working indicator, final logo) and the 28-30 s gradient sweep; Google's three colours appear only in the opening icons and app chrome.
look.type: Warm bookish serif for the title, tagline and wordmark; the product UI keeps its own sans (Google Sans/Roboto in chrome, a geometric sans in Claude's panel, Poppins in generated output).

title_measurements.text: Northfield quarterly business review (slide title in generated deck)

look.depth: Flat. The only depth is the browser window's soft drop shadow and the panel card inside it; the cream ground stays untouched.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Scripted scale-ups on the Extensions menu (6.5-10 s), the side panel (12-14 s), the prompt box (20-28 s) and the plus menu (36-42 s), then pull-backs to the full window for each result.
product_ui.notes: Wide shots (f0003.jpg, f0017.jpg) show a full browser window with 10-14 px body text, unreadable on a phone. The zoomed shots (f0004.jpg, f0014.jpg, f0021.jpg) put the panel text at 25-35 px and read easily. Results are readable only as shape and colour, which is enough to sell them.

motion.text_entry: The title fades in as two lines under settled icons (0.8-1.1 s). Tagline fades in at 51 s and out by 53.7 s. Prompts are typed character by character at about 88 characters a second (window-14-24.709s.jpg).
motion.ui_motion: The Claude panel slides in from the right (strip window-07-11.917s.jpg), toggles flip, a menu opens beneath a clicked button, and the document restyles in place. A coral gradient sweeps left to right over the sheet at 28-30 s.
motion.camera: Whole-window shots alternate with scale-ups of 3-4x on the area being used; the move is a continuous zoom, not a cut, inside the long shot. At 50.4-51 s the window rises out of frame.
motion.eases: Zooms and the panel slide ease out. The title and tagline fades are smooth with no overshoot. Exit of the tagline (53.5-53.7 s) is about 0.2 s against a 0.3 s entrance.

transitions.cause: Title card to Docs window, then Docs wide to menu zoom (6.46), submenu (8.08) and wide Docs (10.08).
Zoom on panel or prompt box, driven by where the user acts next.
Coral gradient sweeps over the sheet as Claude finishes.
Browser window slides up and away to clear the ground for the tagline.
Text fades to blank cream before the logo appears; icons fade into the title likewise.
Menu opens, toggle flips, panel fills, document restyles.

on_screen_lines.text: Tighten up the executive summary and lead with recommendation.
Pull together Q3 budget vs. actuals report: a tab for each team, plus a summary tab with a chart, and flag anything over budget.
Build a QBR deck for Northfield from our Salesforce data and recent call notes.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: Title: 5 words, held 3.2 s against a 2.0 s need. Tagline: 4 words, held 2.6 s against 1.7 s. User prompts are typed too fast to read in full at wide framing, but the zoom lets them be read.

sound.music: Instrumental bed at 90.2 BPM (beat confidence only 0.217). Tags: music 0.819, keyboard_musical 0.52, piano 0.372, synthesizer 0.309, saxophone 0.209. Three sections: 0-3.99 s, 3.99-48.03 s, 48.03-60.01 s.
sound.sfx: None evidenced. Describe tags carry no click or UI sound above 0.2, and I could not hear the film.
sound.vo_music_balance: No voice. Music is the only sound.
sound.energy_arc: Short intro section, a 44 s middle section, and a closing section from 48 s. Silence from 58.46 s to the end. LRA 8.8 LU.
sound.sync_to_picture: Cuts are not locked to the sound: cuts_on_strong_onset_share 0.0 against a chance share of 0.135. The first section boundary at 3.99 s sits 0.55 s before the first cut at 4.54 s.

good.observation: The film shows one job per app, each as typed request then finished result, so a viewer sees what the product does without any narration.
good.evidence: f0007.jpg, f0014.jpg, f0022.jpg; f0009.jpg, f0017.jpg, f0025.jpg

good.observation: Frame 0 is already the title card with the subject (three app icons) and the name, so the hook needs no build-up.
Zooming the camera onto the one control being used makes 12-14 px UI text read at 25-35 px without cutting away from the product.
The generated outputs are designed (forest-green header, KPI tiles, status pills, a six-slide deck), so the payoff looks worth wanting.
A single coral gradient sweep marks the result moment; it is the only graphic effect on top of the UI, so it reads as the film's peak.
The ending is calm: a 4-word tagline fades out to blank before the logo, which holds 6.3 s.

weak.observation: Three-quarters of the runtime is browser chrome that is unreadable at phone width in the wide shots; results are shape and colour only.
Motion is slow and mostly one shot: 40.7 s without a cut, no burst, a static run of 6 s ending at 42 s.
Sound is loud for the target and not tied to picture: -15.4 LUFS integrated, -0.6 dBTP, and cuts land on strong onsets 0 % of the time.
The film names no result number or customer proof; the value is shown but never stated in a line of copy.

rule_candidates.rule: In a demo film, show one typed request and one finished result per product surface; keep typing near 2 s and zoom onto the prompt box so it reads at 25 px or more.
rule_candidates.evidence: Prompts at f0007.jpg, f0014.jpg, f0022.jpg; typing at about 88 characters a second in window-14.

rule_candidates.rule: A long uncut screen-recording shot (40 s, 68 % of runtime) is acceptable when change comes from zooms and state changes about every 2-6 s; hard cuts then cluster at the start, not spread.
rule_candidates.evidence: metrics rhythm: 5 hard cuts, 4 in the first 10 s, longest shot 40.71 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Mark the film's reveal with one non-UI graphic sweep in the brand accent, once, covering about half the frame for about 2 s, and use no other overlay effect.
rule_candidates.evidence: Coral sweep at 28-30 s, f0016.jpg; accent otherwise only on the logo.

rule_candidates.rule: End on tagline then logo: a 4-word line held about 2.6 s, faded to blank ground, then the logo held 6 s or more; both sit at 7-8 % of frame height.
rule_candidates.evidence: Tagline 55 px = 7.6 %; logo hold t=54-60 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Open on the subject plus the title in the first frame: icons and a two-line title, 7.2-7.5 % of frame height, with the first cut after 4.5 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0001.jpg; title lines 54 px and 52 px of 720; first_cut_s 4.54.

rule_candidates.rule: Cut on a narrative step, not a beat: four cuts in 5.5 s each follow one action (open the app, open the menu, choose the entry). Do not expect the cuts to lock to music.
Keep music at -14 LUFS and under -1 dBTP; this film at -15.4 LUFS and -0.6 dBTP fails the second limit by 0.4 dB.
